about.title: About Me
about.description: Passionate about computer science and technology, I am a computer engineering student at Université de Sherbrooke. My journey has allowed me to develop strong skills in programming, algorithm design and web development.
about.interests: Interested in web development, distributed architectures, and artificial intelligence, I enjoy taking on technical challenges and creating innovative solutions.
about.experience: During my studies and my internships, I have had the opportunity to work on various projects, from web application development to embedded system design, including participation in programming competitions.
